items: The procurement officer asked ____ to compare the three supplier quotations before noon.
'Me' is the object of 'asked', so the object pronoun is required.
____ will coordinate the product demonstration for the visiting clients.
'They' is the subject of 'will coordinate', so the subject pronoun is required.
The legal team sent the revised agreement to Ms. Flores and ____.
After the preposition 'to', the object pronoun 'him' is required.
Because ____ works directly with the shipping agent, Ms. Novak can confirm the delivery date.
'She' is the subject of 'works', so the subject pronoun is required.
The branch manager introduced the new accountant to Daniel and ____.
After the preposition 'to', 'me' is part of the compound object, so the object pronoun is required.
Neither Mr. Park nor ____ has access to the confidential payroll file.
The pronoun is part of the compound subject of 'has access', so the subject pronoun 'they' is required.
The event planner reminded Sofia and ____ about the change in venue.
'Us' is part of the compound object of 'reminded', so the object pronoun is required.
If ____ approve the revised budget today, the project can begin next week.
'We' is the subject of 'approve', so the subject pronoun is required.
The customer service supervisor thanked ____ for staying late to resolve the complaint.
'Her' is the object of 'thanked', so the object pronoun is required.
____ has been selected to lead the software migration project.
'He' is the subject of 'has been selected', so the subject pronoun is required.
Please reserve two seats for Mr. Ito and ____ on the afternoon flight.
After the preposition 'for', 'me' is part of the compound object, so the object pronoun is required.
Although ____ joined the company only last month, Ms. Reed already understands the ordering process.
'She' is the subject of 'joined', so the subject pronoun is required.
The technician showed ____ how to restart the backup server safely.
'Them' is the object of 'showed', so the object pronoun is required.
Both Mr. Ahmed and ____ will represent the company at the trade fair.
'She' is part of the compound subject of 'will represent', so the subject pronoun is required.
The director asked the consultants to send ____ the final cost estimate by Thursday.
'Us' is the indirect object of 'send', so the object pronoun is required.
Since ____ oversees the maintenance schedule, Mr. Brown should be informed about the inspection.
'He' is the subject of 'oversees', so the subject pronoun is required.
The sales manager will discuss the revised targets with ____ after the morning briefing.
After the preposition 'with', the object pronoun 'me' is required.
____ were asked to submit travel receipts within five business days.
'They' is the subject of 'were asked', so the subject pronoun is required.
The hiring manager invited Carlos and ____ to a second interview.
'Her' is part of the compound object of 'invited', so the object pronoun is required.
Only ____ can reset administrator passwords for the accounting system.
'He' is the subject of 'can reset', so the subject pronoun is required.
The courier handed ____ the package that required a signature.
'Us' is the indirect object of 'handed', so the object pronoun is required.
After the presentation, ____ will answer questions from the board members.
'She' is the subject of 'will answer', so the subject pronoun is required.
The warehouse supervisor assigned Mark and ____ to check the incoming shipment.
'Me' is part of the compound object of 'assigned', so the object pronoun is required.
When ____ receive the updated floor plan, we will confirm the equipment locations.
'We' is the subject of 'receive', so the subject pronoun is required.
The conference organizer contacted ____ to confirm the speaker's arrival time.
'Him' is the object of 'contacted', so the object pronoun is required.
